subFinder — per-PUL test-set report

All 1030 held-out PULs from the rep_1 seed-42 5-fold OOF run, with calibrated probabilities, p-values, signature genes, and literature-match badges.
Model: cpu__ET500_log2 · temperature scaling, mean T = 0.700 · top-1 OOF acc = 0.9029 · top-3 OOF acc = 0.9680

How to read these reports

Every PUL is run through the deployed calibrated model (cpu__ET500_log2, mean T ≈ 0.70) and gets a probability distribution over all 12 substrate classes. Below are 6 hand-picked test PULs shown in full prediction form: one row per substrate, sorted by descending calibrated probability, with the p-value under a uniform-Dirichlet null and the leave-one-token-out signature genes (cached for the TRUE class and the argmax class only).

Use the per-substrate tabs above to browse every test PUL grouped by ground-truth class — useful for inspecting, e.g., "every test PUL whose TRUE substrate is fructan."

Legend: ✓ correct top-1 ✗ TRUE at rank N GH13 literature canonical (exact match) · GH16 literature canonical (via alias collapse) · GH99 CAZy but not in lit canon for this class · LacI non-CAZy regulator/transporter.
